name: nexora-os
description: Nexora OS monorepo: multi-model AI academic operating system for assignments, labs, reports, coding, and AI learning.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,ml -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @nexora/types && npm run build --workspace @nexora/config && npm run build --workspace @nexora/api && npm run build --workspace @nexora/web
scripts.build:web: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @nexora/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nexora/types && npm run build --workspace @nexora/config && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexora/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexora/types && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexora/config && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexora/web
